name: @pipeworx/mcp-kr-law

tools.name: kr_law_search
tools.description: Search South Korean national statutes by title keyword (국가법령정보, Ministry of Government Legislation). Returns each matching law's id, mst (version id — pass to kr_law_article/kr_law_history), ministry, promulgation/effective dates, and whether it is the current ("현행") or a superseded ("연혁") version. BYOK: requires your own OC from open.law.go.kr (Korean real-name verification to register); pass it as _apiKey.

query.description: Title keyword, Korean or romanized, e.g. "도로교통법" (Road Traffic Act) or "개인정보".

status.description: Narrow to currently-in-force laws only ("current") or search as-is ("all", default). "historical" still returns the general list; filter client-side on the returned "status" field for superseded versions.

_apiKey.description: Your own OC (Open API user id) from https://open.law.go.kr/LSO/main.do. The Ministry's public demo id "test" works here for smoke-testing.

tools.name: kr_law_article
tools.description: Fetch ONE article (조문) of a South Korean statute by mst (from kr_law_search) and article_no (e.g. "5" or "4-2" for 제4조의2). Never returns the whole law body. Omit article_no to get a paginated table of contents (article numbers + titles) instead. Returns the article's own text, paragraphs (항) and items (호), its own effective date (which can differ from the law's), and law-level metadata (promulgation date, effective date, ministry) kept as separate fields. BYOK: requires your own OC; pass it as _apiKey.

mst.description: Law version id (법령일련번호) from kr_law_search's "mst" field.

article_no.description: Article number, e.g. "5", or "4-2" for a branch article (제4조의2). Omit for a table of contents.

display.description: Table-of-contents mode only: entries per page, 1-200 (default 50).

_apiKey.description: Your own OC (Open API user id) from https://open.law.go.kr/LSO/main.do. The Ministry's public demo id "test" works here for smoke-testing.

tools.name: kr_law_history
tools.description: Revision history for a South Korean statute: every promulgation with its own date, promulgation number, and entry-into-force date, each as a separate historical mst you can pass to kr_law_article. Requires the caller's OC to have the 법령연혁 (law history) service separately enabled under My Applications at open.law.go.kr — if it is not, this throws a specific, actionable upstream error rather than a generic failure. BYOK: pass your OC as _apiKey.

mst.description: Law version id (법령일련번호) from kr_law_search's "mst" field.

_apiKey.description: Your own OC (Open API user id) from https://open.law.go.kr/LSO/main.do, with 법령연혁 enabled under My Applications.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-kr-law forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the kr-law pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
